verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs describe connecting *to* remote MCP servers as a client-side feature (portkey-docs-17), but there is no evidence that Portkey itself exposes an official MCP server endpoint that external agents can connect to. Missing for 10: any documentation of Portkey hosting/serving an MCP endpoint, MCP server setup instructions, or third-party confirmation of agents connecting via Portkey's MCP server.
